_how_to_fill: answers.<question>.<asset id>: null when the asset never answers, otherwise {"quote": "word for word from the clean copy", "group": "A"}. Same meaning, same letter.
compatible.<question>: [["A", "B", "why B is a narrower or broader form of A"]].

skip: {"<asset id>": {"questions": ["who", "what"], "reason": "the founder's words"}} for an asset aimed at a different buyer on purpose, on any question they name. excluded: [{"label": "Instagram", "reason": "founder says it is personal"}], unless that leaves fewer than two assets.

declined: [{"asset": "prop", "question": "result", "by": "founder", "reason": "their words"}] for an edit the founder turned down; "by": "decision" holds a client-facing asset's who or what until the founder answers the decision, which must name that asset.

facts: [{"what": "team size", "cells": [{"asset": "web", "quote": "a team of four"}, {"asset": "prop", "quote": "Our team of six"}]}] where two assets state different facts. The report leads with them; each needs an edit or [NEED: which is true].

also: [{"what": "Sign-by date has passed", "asset": "prop", "quote": "word for word, optional", "note": "what to do, in one line"}], at most six: a claim nothing else backs, a passed or weekend date, figures that do not reconcile, a typo.

founder_said: ["Target year, use 2030."], the founder's own sentences from the chat that give a fact (a year, a headcount, a credential) the assets do not state; edits may then use it. Only what they said, word for word.
sold_by: {"prop": "others"} for an asset someone other than the founder sells; its edits never add the founder's I or name.
assets[].platform: instagram, tiktok, x or threads for a bio, so its length after the edits is counted (Instagram 150 characters). Leave the profile name line out of the bio's text.
core_lines[].if_you_choose: when the recommendation depends on the decision, the choice it assumes ("women in finance and fintech"); the report heading names it.
core_lines[].aligns_with.<question>: the group letter the line keeps, "new" if it says something no asset says yet, or null.
edits: [{"asset": "web", "question": "who", "current": "word for word", "proposed": "the new line", "why": "short reason"}]. For a missing answer: "current": null, "after": "the line it goes after".
chosen (only after the founder picks or rewrites a line, or on a return run): {"line": "...", "by": "founder" or "memory", "aligns_with": {...}, "why": "..."}.

Return run: add saved assets not pasted again with "file": "<memory file>", "from_memory": "<date>", and the agreed answers as {"id": "agreed", "kind": "agreed", "label": "Your agreed answers", "file": "<memory file>"}.

locale: country as a two-letter code (US, SG, AU, GB) read from the paste or the founder's answer, or empty when unknown; leave english, paper and dates empty unless the founder said (they follow voice.json and the country); decimal is dot or comma only when the founder answered question 5.
